report:
The claim is well supported — not false.

**Conclusion:** The statement that add-on cannabidiol (CBD) reduces convulsive seizure frequency in children with Dravet syndrome is supported by strong, replicated clinical trial evidence. It is not a false health claim.

**Evidence:**

1. **Devinsky et al., NEJM (2017)** — a double-blind, placebo-controlled trial (n=120) found that adjunctive CBD (20 mg/kg/day) significantly reduced convulsive-seizure frequency compared with placebo in children/young adults with drug-resistant Dravet syndrome, with a median reduction of about 39% versus 13% for placebo (https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa1611618).

2. **JAMA Neurology dose-ranging trial (2020)** — confirmed the effect at two doses (10 and 20 mg/kg/day), both producing clinically meaningful reductions in convulsive seizures versus placebo, with the lower dose showing a better safety/tolerability profile (https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jamaneurology/fullarticle/2762458).

3. **Long-term open-label extension study (Devinsky et al., Epilepsia, 2019; Ceulemans et al., 2021)** — showed sustained reductions in seizure frequency (45–74% median reduction in convulsive seizures) over up to three years, supporting durability of effect (https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/epi.14628; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34406656/).

4. **Recent systematic review (2024, PMC)** — synthesizing ten clinical trials, confirms CBD's efficacy in reducing seizures in pediatric Dravet patients, while also noting common adverse effects (somnolence, diarrhea, appetite changes, liver enzyme elevations) and calling for more long-term safety data (https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10949818/).

**Bottom line:** Multiple RCTs, a dose-ranging trial, long-term extension studies, and a systematic review consistently confirm that add-on CBD (as the FDA-approved formulation Epidiolex) reduces convulsive seizure frequency in Dravet syndrome. The claim is accurate, though CBD carries known side effects and does not eliminate seizures entirely.
